description: Preflight the Android/Flutter workspace, saved test cases, ADB availability, and target readiness before a device test workflow. Read-only: it does not build, install, launch, or interact with the app.

projectPath.description: Project/workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

requireDevice.description: When true, no ready target is a blocker; set false for a planning-only preflight.

targetId.description: Target to validate. Defaults to the session target; if omitted, one ready target is selected only when unambiguous.
